headline: Failed House resolution would have directed the President to remove U.S. troops from unauthorized hostilities in or against Venezuela.
what_it_does: This resolution would have directed the President to pull U.S. Armed Forces out of hostilities within or against Venezuela. The only exception would have been if Congress had passed a declaration of war or a specific authorization to use military force there. The House voted it down on December 17, 2025.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the U.S. Armed Forces
who_it_affects.how: Troops involved in hostilities in or against Venezuela would have been removed unless Congress authorized the military action.
The President would have been directed to end U.S. military hostilities involving Venezuela that Congress had not approved.
Congress would have had to pass a declaration of war or a use-of-force authorization for such military action to continue.
U.S. military hostilities in their country would have had to end unless Congress approved them.
